content.text:
I found three CSS regressions in `site/css/styles.css` and reverted each. The visual tests now pass at desktop and phone size against the original baselines, so nothing needed approving.

1. **"Tell Me More" button:** `.btn-xl` had vertical padding of `1.875rem`, which made the button and the hero 20px taller and pushed the rest of the page down. I set it back to `1.25rem`.
2. **Hero text on phones:** `.masthead-subheading` had `line-height: 0.75rem`, which pulled the hero heading and button up about 12px. I set it back to `1.5rem`. Desktop overrides this value, so only phones were affected.
3. **Round images:** `.rounded-circle` had `border-radius: 25%`, which turned the timeline and team photos into rounded squares. I set it back to `50%`.

The git history has only the initial commit, so I couldn't see the original values. I picked these because they restore the baseline layout, and they match the stock Start Bootstrap theme.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
